en.text: Do I look like a farmer?

original: 何も見えなかったよ。

en.text: I couldn't see a thing.
We couldn't see a thing.

original: あの絵は見える？

en.text: Can you see the picture?

original: そんな遠くは見えないよ。

en.text: I can't see that far.

original: 遠くは見える？

en.text: Can you see far?

original: この建物は現代的に見える。

en.text: This building looks very modern.

original: 何もかもが素敵に見えた。

en.text: Everything looked nice.

original: 彼は生まれつき目が見えなかった。

en.text: He was blind from birth.

original: 娘は、目が見えないんだ。

en.text: My daughter is blind.

original: 僕の兄ちゃん、何歳に見える？

en.text: How old does my brother look?

original: 全部同じに見えるんだけど。

en.text: Everything looks the same.

original: はるか彼方に明かりが見えた。

en.text: We saw a light far away.

original: 遠くに稲光が見えた。

en.text: I saw flashes of lightning in the distance.

original: 博物館の参観者の中にちらほら外国人が見えた。

en.text: There was a sprinkling of foreigners among the visitors in the museum.

original: 眼鏡がないと見えないよ。

en.text: I can't see without my glasses.

original: 世界遺産でもある宮島の「厳島神社」は、潮が満ちると神社全体がまるで海に浮かんでいるかのように見えます。その姿は神秘的で、世界中から訪れる観光客を魅了し続けています。

en.text: Also known for being a world heritage site, the Itsukushima Shrine in Miyajima gives the impression that it is floating in the ocean whenever the tides come in. Its mystical appearance continues to attract tourists from all over the world.

original: カーテンが閉まってて中が見えないよ。

en.text: I can't see in because the curtains are closed.

original: 自宅から海が見えるのよ。

en.text: We can see the ocean from our house.

original: 汚れた窓から、雨にぬれた街が見える。

en.text: Through the dirty window, I see the city soaked in the rain.

original: 何も聞こえないし、見えないし。

en.text: I can't hear or see anything.
I can't hear anything and I can't see anything.

original: 宇宙から地球を見ると、すごく小さく見えます。

en.text: From space, the earth looks quite small.

original: 英語で話すと、子供っぽく見える気がする。

en.text: I feel like I look childish when I speak in English.

original: 遠くに島が見えますよ。

en.text: You can see the island in the distance.

original: 中途半端に見えてしまい微妙だ。

en.text: I don't know, it looks unfinished.

original: 簡単そうに見えるけど、結構体力消耗するなぁ。

en.text: It looks easy, but it's pretty exhausting.

original: 星空を見上げると、音もしないで何匹も蝙蝠が飛んでいる。その姿は見えないが、瞬間瞬間光を消す星の工合から、気味の悪い畜類の飛んでいるのが感じられるのである。

en.text: If you look up at the starry sky, you'll find many bats on the wing, making not a sound. You can't quite make them out, but, from the way the stars disappear moment by moment, you can sense their eerily flying about.

original: 遠くに明かりが見えたときは喜んだよ。

en.text: We were glad when we saw a light in the distance.

original: 最近目に見えて治安が悪くなった。

en.text: Recently, it's become clear that public order has deteriorated.

original: トムは相変わらず若く見えるな。

en.text: Tom looks as young as ever.
Tom still looks young.

original: 何か見えるけど、何か分かんない。

en.text: I see something, but I don't know what it is.

original: 隣の芝生は青く見える。

en.text: The grass is always greener on the other side.

original: 暗くて見えません。

en.text: It's too dark to see.

original: 息子は、目が見えないんです。

en.text: My son is blind.

original: 髭があると老けて見えるよ。

en.text: Your beard makes you look old.

original: 海が見える部屋がいいな。

en.text: I want a room with a sea view.
I'd like a room with a sea view.
I'd like a room with a view of the sea.
I'd like a room that looks out on the sea.

original: 虹って、何色に見える？

en.text: How many colours can you see in the rainbow?

original: 列車の窓越しに富士山が見えた。

en.text: I saw Mt Fuji through the train window.

original: 電車の窓から富士山が見えたんだ。

en.text: I saw Mt Fuji through the train window.

original: 車窓から富士山が見えました。

en.text: I saw Mt Fuji through the train window.

original: 展望台から遠くの街が霞んで見える。

en.text: From the observation platform, you can just barely make out the town in the distance.

original: トムが小さい頃は本当にお母さんっ子で、私の姿が見えなくなるだけで泣いてたのよ。

en.text: When Tom was little, he was such a mama's boy. He would cry if he couldn't see me.

original: お前の魂胆見え見えなんだよ。

en.text: Your intentions are easy to see, you know.
Your intentions are clear as day.

original: 便秘の様に見えます。

en.text: You look constipated.

original: 全部同じに見えるけど。

en.text: They all look the same.

original: 大通りを外れて細い道に入ると、目的地のカフェが見えてきた。

en.text: When I went off the main street and entered a narrow alley, I spotted the cafe I was headed for.
